self_assessment: _parse_value now takes the component kind and scales hue by 359 (others 255); to_py dispatches through a converters map keyed on rgb/rgba/hsv/hsva, validating the function name and that the component count equals len(kind), zipping kind chars to values so hue is identified. Verified directly against PyQt5: hsv(100%,100%,100%) now yields hue 359 (was 254) and hsv(10%,...) yields 35; RGB/A percentage behaviour is byte-identical to the base commit; all malformed inputs (wrong arity, unknown function) raise ValidationError. The repo's own pytest suite cannot run here (2019-era conftest is incompatible with modern pytest hookspecs).
